evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Output Divergence Rate (ODR), which measures how often SE changes an LLM's intent classification relative to clean speech, and benchmark five conditions on 2,974 SLURP clips using Whisper large-v3 and wav2vec2-large cascades.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Speech enhancement (SE) is commonly applied as a preprocessing step in spoken AI pipelines under the assumption that better audio quality improves downstream task performance.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Audio quality metrics range from near-zero to moderate correlation with ODR (SQUIM-MOS $ρ=-0.068$, PESQ $ρ=-0.467$).

declaredVenue: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 12 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables
